name: Contraband VR Cinema
summary:
CONTRABAND is a VR screening room for independent films, AI-made features, and documentaries that never found a home in traditional distribution.

Every screening happens at a set time, with a real audience. No pausing, no skipping, no watching alone. The room fades away when the film starts, so every seat is the best seat in the house.
You cannot see other viewers, but you can hear them. That shared reaction, laughter, silence, tension, is what makes cinema feel different from streaming at home.
